name: Agricultural land classification
fact: 585 classifications; 1 provider; collector 2026-07-22; new data 2024-07-15; MHCLG-created platform origin with Natural England attribution.
gate: Classification polygons are screening evidence only; exact parcel intersection, current survey resolution and BMV interpretation remain required.

name: Agricultural land classification screen
fact: Official screen describes ALC as a method for assessing farmland quality and records Natural England consultation guidance for certain losses of more than 20 hectares of BMV land.
gate: Guidance context does not determine a parcel's grade, proposal area, consultation requirement or planning outcome.

name: Protected wreck site
fact: 58 sites; 1 provider; collector and new-data date 2026-07-22; all data from authoritative sources; Historic England attribution.
gate: Designation geometry and legislation must still be related to an exact candidate parcel/proposal; offshore or distant records cannot influence a land score by proximity alone.

name: Protected wreck sites design surface
fact: On the platform; expected 57 records; fortnightly updates; related protected-wreck-site dataset; no technical specification.
gate: Expected-count difference from the live 58-record dataset is recorded; current dataset and designation documentation take precedence.

name: Road classification design surface
fact: Screen stage; A, B, classified unnumbered and unclassified roads; records/frequency unknown; no related dataset or technical specification.
gate: Classification narrative cannot establish an exact highway boundary, access right, frontage or transport capacity.

name: Open roads design surface
fact: Co-design; six-month update expectation; OS Open Roads identified as a high-level approximate carriageway-centreline network; no related Planning Data dataset or specification.
gate: Approximate centrelines cannot prove legal highway extent, vehicular access, junction capacity or exact parcel frontage.

name: Public rights of way design surface
